resources.string: Everything runs on your phone: the .gguf models, the inference, the chat history. There is no internet permission and no network request - and CI verifies that at the binary level too.
Where did you put your .gguf files? Pick that folder from the Models screen. aura only registers them in place; no file is ever copied or moved.
This app installs only from GitHub Releases (signed APK). You will need to allow "install unknown apps" for your browser/file manager - the full guide is in the repo README.
